integrity: A complete direct analytic proof and a runnable independent finite checker are embedded. Numerical checks do not substitute for the proof; independent scientific audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform binomial points on one circle with hard radius cutoff only; no higher-dimensional, line-boundary, or Poisson model extension is claimed. Literature priority remains uncertain because one pertinent original paper and an older broad monograph were not fully inspected.
title: A sharp two-threshold edge–isolation covariance law for circular random geometric graphs
